purpose: Develop a gathered-MLP intermediate refresh with shared CFG selection, source quality and full group cost; enter RA/A+P0 without a standalone win gate.
layer_choice: Four dispersed deep layers chosen before real P0 errors/costs; sparse-attention exclusions are not MLP exclusions.
actual_mask_quota: floor(full_blocks*fraction)*block_size; identical count for rotation and random. Record actual shape and density.
rotation_opportunity: 0 at step12, 1 at step30; same per-CFG positions; independent of error or timing results.
working_state: Same paid shallow probes and actual past own-branch D projections. Restore the additional P0 inventory and the separate full net/solver/conditions/RNG/buffers inventory.
cost_scope: Full deep Block group with current full attention/norm/modulation/gate, selected MLP gather/scatter and projection/provenance writes, current head/RF conversion; include CPU selection and device index movement. This is not full refresh or clean end-to-end latency.

cost_controls.method_order: Rotate six methods by origin index, reverse in alternating measured repetitions; snapshot/teacher/hash/write outside group interval and paid to research budget.

paired_guided_objective: Actual guided weights8/-7; preserve branch error energies and cross term; report every scene/state.
full_dense_actual_correctness: Same-origin DENSE_REFERENCE and DENSE_WITH_P0 full outputs directly equal; observe real selected Linear rows for P. Report partial BF16 arithmetic and final error distributions separately from implementation correctness.
cache_resource_evidence: Logical projection/provenance bytes plus actual peak allocated/reserved/VRAM; account live/saved/restored/transaction clones and attention workspace; gate before GPU copies.
next_execution_card_must_freeze: Complete parent/video controls, repetitions, all origin/method outputs, source/payload, snapshot resources and full forecast; no subset launch or late removal of controls.
